paragraphs: Property owners of San Francisco Legacy Businesses may be able to get this grant every year. It is to help Legacy Businesses stay open in San Francisco.

sections.heading: Read the rules and regulations
paragraphs: Read the Business Stabilization Grant rules and regulations
Note: Business Stabilization Grant recipients must share at least 50% of the award with their Legacy Business tenants.

sections.heading: Re-applications
paragraphs: Existing grantees must submit a re-application every year of the eligible lease. We send re-application instructions via email, with a unique link to re-apply. If you haven't received yours for the 2026-27 fiscal year email legacybusiness@sfgov.org .

sections.heading: New applications are closed
paragraphs: Due to funding constraints, we aren't accepting new Business Stabilization applications.
Contact us: for more information, email legacybusiness@sfgov.org or call 415-554-6680.
